summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade. The audit checks ARTSTUDI 101 and 102, two more 100-level ARTSTUDI courses, two 200-level ARTSTUDI courses, ARTHIST 5, and two art history electives (any ARTHIST course, or at most one FILMEDIA course), toward the 36 units the minor needs. An outside art history course your advisor approves, and at most one course (up to 5 units) from another university or Bing Overseas Studies, are moved in by hand.

program.why: Grading: "All required and elective courses must be taken for a letter grade."

hgOVn4kz-text.why: "Curricular Flow / Students are strongly encouraged to take the required core program courses ... early in their minor course flow". Advice on order. The Major Seminar, which "can count as one 200-level elective if the student is accepted", is ARTSTUDI 201, already in the 200-level ARTSTUDI pool, and "Completing a full year of ITALIC can count as four credits towards either one Art History elective or one lower 100-level Art Practice elective" is a substitution the student moves in by hand, as the elective rules' notes say. Nothing new to check.

7oXAxS4b.why: "Students must complete two lower-level ARTSTUDI courses. Any 100-level ARTSTUDI course may be applied toward the lower-level Art Practice elective requirement."

58fAbTUg.why: "Any 200-level ARTSTUDI course may be applied toward the lower-level Art Practice elective requirement." This is the Upper Level Courses rule, so the sentence's "lower-level" reads as the upper-level electives.

OKkaHpSu.why: "Any ARTHIST course may be applied toward the Art History elective requirement. One Film & Media Studies course may satisfy an art history/critical theory elective." A course from another department with advisor approval is moved in by hand.
